messages.subject: Item Response Theory in R and IRTPRO - Livestream Seminar
parts:
Hi everyone

Last chance to sign up for our 2-day seminar Item Response Theory in R and IRTPRO, running Nov 20 - 21, provides a comprehensive introduction to Item Response Theory (IRT), covering fundamental concepts, model specification, parameter estimation, and practical applications using R and IRTPRO. Participants will gain hands-on experience and theoretical knowledge to enhance the quality and precision of their research, including how to conduct IRT modeling and interpret the results for academic research and applied applications.

Sign up today to secure your spot in this unique event, and please feel free to tell your colleagues and students.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
